mainEntity.name: How do I dictate on a Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enable Dictation in Keyboard settings, click a destination field, press the dictation shortcut, speak, and review the inserted text before using it.

mainEntity.name: Can I dictate on Mac without the cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in supported workflows. Apple asks users to check their Dictation settings for processing details. Voice Control works offline after setup. Gojo uses a downloaded local model.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Dictation and Voice Control?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dictation enters text. Voice Control can also navigate, click, select, and edit the Mac by voice.

blocks.label: Short answer
blocks.copy: To dictate on a Mac, enable Dictation in Keyboard settings, click where the words should go, press the dictation shortcut, speak, then review the text. Use Voice Control for hands-free Mac control. Use Gojo when you want local-model dictation that types into the focused field.
points: Hands-free navigation and editing: Voice Control.
Local-model dictation into the current text field: Gojo.

items.s: Open System Settings and go to Keyboard.
Turn on Dictation and choose the shortcut, language, and microphone you want to use.
Click into the app where text should appear.
Press the dictation shortcut, speak clearly, and stop dictation when you are done.
Read the text before sending. Names, product terms, punctuation, and code still need review.

content.s: Apple says the text beneath Dictation in Keyboard settings explains whether general voice input and transcripts are processed on-device or sent to Siri servers. Check that setting on the Mac you actually use.

blocks.text: Use Voice Control when speech should control the Mac

content.s: Voice Control is different from ordinary dictation. It can navigate, click, select text, and edit with spoken commands. Apple says it requires internet for a one-time file download, then works without an internet connection.

blocks.text: Use Gojo for local dictation into the current field

content.s: Gojo downloads a local speech model and types dictated text into the field that is already active. That matters when you want the words to land in Messages, Notes, Slack, a browser form, or a document without copying from a transcript app. Read the

blocks.text: Check privacy before you start dictating

items.s: Does the selected workflow process speech on-device, in a cloud service, or both depending on mode?
Does the app store audio, transcripts, corrections, or history?
Does it need microphone, Accessibility, automation, or file access permissions?
Does the receiving app sync the inserted text after dictation?
